title: Inspect and extend: Build a screen flow around one observable store
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/ContentView.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve environment object injection, navigationstack, and view actions.
problem: SwiftUI views describe the screens from current model state. Follow the shared store from the app root into lists, reusable cards, profile, and detail actions, then see state changes refresh the UI. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/ContentView.swift` and the related project files: Sources/ContentView.swift; Sources/Components.swift; Sources/Screens/DiscoverView.swift; Sources/Screens/SavedView.swift; Sources/Screens/ProjectDetailView.swift; Sources/Screens/ProfileView.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to environment object injection, navigationstack, and view actions.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The source is a compact educational client, not production Kickstarter UI.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: SwiftUI views describe the screens from current model state. Follow the shared store from the app root into lists, reusable cards, profile, and detail actions, then see state changes refresh the UI.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/ContentView.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
